candidate.definition_en: A person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a holder of an elected office.
candidate.explanation_ar: الشخص اللي بيشتغل في السياسة زي الوزير أو عضو البرلمان.

senses.definition_en: A person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a holder of an elected office.
senses.definition_ar: شخص يعمل في مجال السياسة، وخاصة من يشغل منصباً منتخباً.
examples: She wants to be a politician.
He is a very popular local politician.
